searchText: What is the tool recommended to generate a top-up deposit for a compounding validator. The ethereum launchpad now points to ethstaker's deposit-cli which doesn't list the contributors in the github. The previous `staking-deposit-cli` doesn't really list top ups. `ethdo` used to do this so I assume that still works. Anything else? The signature is irrelevant for this so perhaps I'll do it myself, I guess the only thing is computing the sha of the ssz for the depositdata. I'm surprised that a quick google search did not find many results, surprisingly enough this still open issue by Hsiao-Wei https://github.com/ethereum/staking-deposit-cli/issues/39. yeah I think it'll be faster and I'll feel safer if I write my own, it should take just a few minutes I wrote my own and sent it. It was scary as hell to send a deposit with a zero withdrawal credential (don't know why I can't add the 4th letter) congrats! Can't use the same reaction twice. Has anyone ever worked on an arbitrary bot on python I am working on one but having issues with ABIs I wrote mine in typescript, I gave up on Python. I dislike UIs but I think this should be in the launchpad itself. This doesn't expose the validator keys in any way so it should be a regular web3 app where you connect a wallet that doesn't need to be related to the validator at all. I really think the community wants this instead of having to rely on coding this. Not sure who runs the launchpad, <@550420431744794624> you used to have something to do with this do you know? Probably ethstaker already has this tool available? https://deposit-cli.ethstaker.cc/partial_deposit.html https://github.com/eth-educators/ethstaker-deposit-cli should be the links for top ups but i would ask the ethstaker people for a concrete doc Yeah but the point is that this doesn't need to be part of the usual workflow for deposits: partial topups don't require any wallet that is connected to any validator at all. This could be the regular metamask experience on an online browser
